drift_interpretation: different stationary test distribution, not a within-run regime change or a validation of rolling adaptation
perturbation_location: near gate abs(q-.25)<.025 versus abs(q-.25)>.12, interior z ensures equal number and magnitude of changed regional marginal probabilities
spatial_threshold: abstract regional exceedance probability z, not an actual European q90 threshold
process: active-day clusters bridging one empty day; first six actual hours
MCSE: between-replicate SD / sqrt(replications); synchronized paired replicate identifiers
phase_fixture: isolated one-hour opportunities; observed phase changes conditional information; not observed-process coverage or proof of a real onset signal
